Name: Pokemon Mewtwo replaces Wizard
Author: General_Durandal
Description:
The wizard is replaced with Mewtwo!

This mod replaces the Wizard.xnb files located in the Characters and Portraits folders,
so back them up if you want to bring back the normal wizard.
